title: Sunset Loto Lab & auto-Magazine, freeze Career RPG, clean avatar menu and sitemap

spec.problem: Off-mission Loto Lab and auto-Magazine routes and half-wired Mirai Shoji Career RPG routes remain publicly accessible and indexed in sitemap.xml, and the avatar menu still links to /daily-standup (Đi làm ở Nhật).

acceptance.text: Avatar dropdown in learner-app-frame.tsx removes the /{locale}/daily-standup (nav.dailyStandup / Đi làm ở Nhật) link while keeping /{locale}/me, /{locale}/me?tab=settings, locale switcher, and sign-out.

Server redirects in page.tsx route /[locale]/magazine/loto -> /{locale}/levels, /[locale]/magazine and /[locale]/magazine/[slug] -> /{locale}/news, /[locale]/daily-standup, /[locale]/career, /[locale]/story/arcs, /[locale]/story/arcs/[slug], and /[locale]/story/chapters/[id] -> /{locale}/scenarios, and /[locale]/review-inbox-preview -> /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review while leaving all component files on disk (Strategy a).
app/sitemap.ts removes magazine and story/arcs from PUBLIC_ROUTES and sitemap.test.ts verifies both routes are excluded across vi, ja, and en.
Route, nav, and sitemap tests assert the new contracts with contract-change justification per ENGINEERING_POLICY.md §5; theme-contrast.regression.test.ts and verify-frontend pass with zero new debt.

spec.expected_behavior: Avatar dropdown omits /daily-standup while keeping /me, /me?tab=settings, locale switcher, and sign-out; the 9 sunset/frozen page routes server-redirect to /{locale}/levels, /{locale}/news, /{locale}/scenarios, or /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review; app/sitemap.ts excludes magazine and story/arcs; all component files remain untouched on disk.
spec.observed_behavior: Avatar dropdown in learner-app-frame.tsx renders /daily-standup (nav.dailyStandup); 9 sunset/frozen page routes render magazine/loto/career-rpg views; app/sitemap.ts includes magazine and story/arcs in PUBLIC_ROUTES.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert learner-app-frame.tsx, the 9 route page.tsx redirects, sitemap.ts, and updated tests; all underlying components remain on disk under Strategy (a).

classification.rationale: Web-only Strategy (a) sunset/freeze: removes /daily-standup from avatar dropdown, replaces 9 route page.tsx files with Next.js server redirect(), removes magazine and story/arcs from sitemap.ts, and updates tests while leaving all component files on disk and touching no backend, database, deploy, or admin code.

risk_acknowledgements.reason: Contract change per WEB-442 / ENGINEERING_POLICY.md §5: /[locale]/magazine is intentionally sunset under Strategy (a) and replaced with a server redirect to /{locale}/news. Previously the page fetched /api/magazine, normalized ?kind aliases, handled pagination clamping, and rendered MagazinePageClient or a 503 alert (5 tests, 14 assertions). The new contract requires an immediate server redirect across vi/ja/en and legacy ?kind/?page query params with zero /api/magazine fetch calls (2 tests, 6 assertions). Underlying magazine/_components/* and magazine-kinds.ts remain on disk with their existing component unit tests intact; magazine/[slug]/page.test.ts was likewise updated from article/notFound/503 loading to redirect-only behavior.
